parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include the data about pending orders. Valid values:

*   **false** (default)
*   **true**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPN gateway.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPN gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-gateway --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1r3v1xqkl0w519g0000 --include-reservation-data true --region cn-hangzhou
